description: Render a Drawbridge/draw.io network diagram to an output format (svg, png, drawio, dot, csv, netbox.csv, netbox-devices.csv, describe.json, clab.yml, drawio.svg, drawio.png, html). Returns the exported content. CHOOSING `kind`: `drawio` when the user will open or edit the drawing (this is usually what they want, and it is the only one they can change); `svg` to embed in a document or a page; `png` to show inline in a chat; `drawio.svg` / `drawio.png` for ONE file that is both: a picture a wiki, a README or Obsidian shows, with the whole drawing inside it, which Drawbridge and draw.io open for editing; `describe.json` to READ a drawing back and reason about it; `csv` / `netbox.csv` for a cable schedule and `netbox-devices.csv` for the hardware; `dot` to hand the topology on; `clab.yml` to turn the design into a Containerlab topology you can deploy; `html` for one self-contained page that opens offline in any browser — every page, zoom, search and the cable schedule — to hand a drawing to someone without Drawbridge (save it as a file; it is too large to show in a chat). Results carry `name`: a suggested basename for this diagram. Write every file for one diagram into its own directory named after it — <name>/<name>.drawio, <name>/<name>.svg, <name>/<name>.cables.csv — so two diagrams never share a directory.

name.description: Basename to use for this diagram instead of the one derived from its content. Slugified; wins over the document’s own name.

theme.description: Render theme. Omit to follow the OS appearance; pin it for machine-independent output.

name: export
